name: minio-unconditional
fault_model: network loss/delay, client abandon; owner up (no owner crash or reboot)
notes: Run with: python3 evicon_review.py measure minio (release 067: MinIO on VM-B through docker compose with credentials from VM-C's environment or random ones for the measurement, passed on stdin; the fault proxy runs inside the probe on VM-C). The bucket is versioned: every effect is an object version.
